findings.message: 1 credential value(s) are inlined in node parameters or embedded credential data.
findings.fix: Move each value into an n8n credential and reference it; then re-export.

findings.message: No error workflow is configured; failed runs fail silently.
findings.fix: Set Settings → Error Workflow to a workflow that starts with an Error Trigger.

findings.message: Workflow export contains pinned test data.
findings.fix: Unpin data before exporting; pinned data can leak customer records.
Require header or basic authentication, or add a signature check node.

findings.message: Webhook-driven workflow writes to an external system with no duplicate guard.
findings.fix: Add a dedupe check (event id lookup, Remove Duplicates, or an IF on last-seen timestamp) before the write.

findings.message: `Enrich Lead` has no retry policy; a single transient failure ends the run.
findings.fix: Enable Retry On Fail with 3 tries and a 1s wait.

findings.message: `Old Slack Ping` has no retry policy; a single transient failure ends the run.
findings.fix: Enable Retry On Fail with 3 tries and a 1s wait.

findings.message: `Store Lead` has no retry policy; a single transient failure ends the run.
findings.fix: Enable Retry On Fail with 3 tries and a 1s wait.

findings.message: `Enrich Lead` makes an HTTP call with no timeout.
findings.fix: Set a timeout (30000 ms is a safe default).

findings.message: Unreachable node(s) from any trigger: Old Slack Ping, Unused Set.
findings.fix: Delete them or connect them; dead branches hide drift.

findings.message: `Old Slack Ping` is disabled and will be skipped silently in production.
findings.fix: Delete it or document why it is disabled.

findings.message: Workflow does not use executionOrder v1.
findings.fix: Set settings.executionOrder to "v1" and re-test branch order.
